Ubicación:

Descripción de la compañía.

Ferrero es una empresa familiar con una perspectiva verdaderamente mundial y progresista y marcas icónicas como Nutella®, Tic Tac®, Ferrero Rocher®, Raffaello®, Kinder Bueno® y Kinder Sorpresa®. El amor por nuestras marcas sigue creciendo al igual que lo hace nuestro alcance internacional. Representada en más de 50 países y con productos vendidos en más de 170, el Grupo Ferrero encanta a numerosas generaciones en todo el planeta. ¿Cuál es el secreto de nuestro éxito mundial? 40,000 empleados especializados que celebran tanto el cuidado como la calidad para forjar un negocio, carreras profesionales y marcas de las que nos sentimos orgullosos. Únete a nosotros, podrías ser uno de ellos.

Acerca del Rol:

Si te apasiona el shopper marketing, quieres entender el comportamiento del consumidor y te motiva aprender sobre la ejecución comercial de marcas líderes ¡esta posición es para ti!

Como Trade Marketing Trainee apoyarás en la implementación de estrategias comerciales centradas en el shopper, colaborando con equipos multifuncionales para una ejecución impecable en el punto de venta. Tendrás la oportunidad de desarrollar distintas habilidades en un entorno colaborativo, contribuyendo directamente al crecimiento de nuestras categorías.

Principales Responsabilidades:

Participarás en la creación e implementación de proyectos de trade marketing, orientados a mejorar la experiencia de compra y fortalecer la presencia de nuestras marcas en el punto de venta.

Formarás parte de un equipo multifuncional en el que podrás desarrollar habilidades de liderazgo, planeación y trabajo en equipo.

Colaborarás en el análisis de datos y desempeño comercial para generar aprendizajes y propuestas que impulsen los resultados del área.

Ferrero comenzó su trayectoria en la pequeña ciudad de Alba en Piamonte, Italia, en 1946. Hoy en día, es una de las empresas de alimentos dulces envasados más grandes del mundo, con muchas marcas icónicas que se venden en todo el mundo. Descubre más sobre Ferrero en ferrero.com

Consumidores, calidad y servicio son la clave de todo cuanto hacemos. Así pues, para cosechar el éxito en Ferrero, deberás orientarte al consumidor y al producto tanto como nosotros: dedicarte a lograr buenos resultados para los clientes en todo el mundo.

title: Academic Partnerships Intern – Digital Marketing & Audience Engagement | Academic Partnerships
description:
Job Description

Bring It

You are a university student who enjoys communication, digital content, and working with people. You bring proficient written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and an interest in education and technology. You can create engaging content using Microsoft PowerPoint, Canva, Microsoft 365, and social media platforms. You communicate confidently in English and Spanish, while Portuguese is a plus. You can work from the SAP office in Monterrey, Mexico, at least three days per week.

Build It

You will create emails, newsletters, social posts, presentations, invitations, and internal communications for Academic Partnerships. You will help plan and deliver virtual, hybrid, and in-person events across Latin America and the Caribbean. Your work will include coordinating speakers, registrations, venues, communications, and event logistics. You will engage with universities, educators, students, customers, and SAP teams across multiple countries. You will also maintain contact lists, reports, presentations, and activity records. Your work will help SAP connect education communities with SAP technologies, experts, and learning opportunities.

Belong

You will join a regional team that connects SAP with universities, schools, educators, and students. The team works across countries and cultures to create useful learning experiences and stronger connections between academia and industry. You will gain regional exposure, work with different SAP functions, and build relationships across the educational ecosystem. You will also develop your communication, project coordination, digital marketing, and stakeholder management skills through real projects.

Como parte de una iniciativa de transformación digital, el área está impulsando proyectos de automatización e Inteligencia Artificial orientados a optimizar sus procesos, reducir tiempos de procesamiento, fortalecer los controles de calidad y mejorar la gestión del conocimiento dentro de la organización.

Como Becario de Mercadotecnia o Publicidad en el área de Cumplimiento Publicitario, participarás en proyectos enfocados en la mejora continua de procesos mediante Inteligencia Artificial, automatización, organización de información y desarrollo de entornos de prueba.

description:
PRÁCTICAS PROFESIONALES Y SERVICIO SOCIAL | COMUNICACIÓN




CADICZA

Departamento · Comunicación y Relaciones Públicas

Modalidad de incorporación · Prácticas profesionales o servicio social.

Modalidad · En línea

País · México

Plazas disponibles · 3




1. DESCRIPCIÓN GENERAL DE LA POSICIÓN




CADICZA, despacho de arquitectura especializado en diseño residencial de lujo, busca integrar estudiantes al área de Comunicación y Relaciones Públicas para fortalecer la presencia pública de la marca, establecer vínculos con medios de comunicación y apoyar la difusión de proyectos e iniciativas del despacho.




La convocatoria está dirigida a estudiantes de Comunicación, Relaciones Públicas, Periodismo, Comunicación Organizacional, Mercadotecnia o carreras afines que quieran adquirir experiencia en comunicación de marca, gestión de prensa y planificación de lanzamientos.




2. ACTIVIDADES Y RESPONSABILIDADES DEL DÍA A DÍA




* Apoyar en la gestión de la marca CADICZA desde el área de relaciones públicas, cuidando la coherencia de sus mensajes y su presentación ante públicos externos.

* Investigar y actualizar el directorio de medios, periodistas y editores de arquitectura, diseño, cultura e interés general.

* Preparar mensajes de acercamiento y dar seguimiento a propuestas de cobertura, entrevistas y colaboraciones con medios.

* Redactar y editar comunicados de prensa, fichas informativas y materiales para la difusión de proyectos.

* Apoyar en la planificación de lanzamientos de proyectos e iniciativas, organizando calendarios, materiales y fechas de difusión.

* Registrar contactos, respuestas y publicaciones para dar seguimiento a los resultados de cada acción de comunicación.




3. REQUISITOS




Escolaridad




* Cursar Comunicación, Relaciones Públicas, Periodismo, Comunicación Organizacional, Mercadotecnia o una carrera afín.

* Estudiar en una institución educativa en México y reunir los requisitos académicos para iniciar prácticas profesionales o servicio social.




Aptitudes




* Buena redacción, ortografía y capacidad para adaptar el tono a distintos públicos.

* Organización para dar seguimiento a contactos, tareas y fechas de entrega.

* Criterio para identificar medios y oportunidades de difusión relevantes para cada proyecto.

* Iniciativa, atención al detalle y disposición para colaborar a distancia.




Software y herramientas




* Manejo de correo electrónico y herramientas de trabajo en línea como Google Docs, Sheets y Drive.

* Se valorará la experiencia con herramientas de planificación editorial, monitoreo de medios o diseño de presentaciones.




Otros




* Residir en México y contar con disponibilidad para cumplir las horas acordadas en modalidad remota.

* Tener interés en la comunicación aplicada a la arquitectura, el diseño o la cultura.




4. BENEFICIOS




Esquema de participación




Prácticas profesionales o servicio social sin remuneracion. La acreditación de horas está sujeta a la autorización de la institución educativa y a la formalización de los documentos correspondientes.




Desarrollo profesional en CADICZA




* Experiencia práctica en relaciones públicas, gestión de prensa y comunicación de marca dentro de un despacho de arquitectura.

* Participación en la preparación y difusión de lanzamientos, desde la definición del mensaje hasta el seguimiento de la cobertura.

* Retroalimentación sobre textos, propuestas de difusión y materiales de comunicación.

* Créditos de colaboración cuando corresponda, acceso a la bolsa de trabajo y acceso a los beneficios de salud disponibles, conforme a sus condiciones.

Business and web strategy. Translate business goals and customer understanding into a focused strategy for the website. Identify the most valuable opportunities and help the team decide what to prioritize and why.
Product positioning and messaging. Understand the audience, the offer and its differentiation. Develop messaging that makes the value clear and gives people a reason to take the next step.

User experience and creative quality. Bring creativity and a discerning eye to user flows, page narratives and content quality. Partner with designers to make the experience clear, engaging and consistent with the brand.
Page structure and copy. Create page structures and write and refine copy yourself, working with the team to carry the strategic intent through to the finished experience.
Paid campaign landing pages. Partner with the Paid team to align landing pages with campaign strategy and intent, helping improve the efficiency of acquisition investment.

Research and web experimentation ideas. Combine customer research, business insights and performance data to frame useful hypotheses. Work with CRO to interpret results and decide what to test or improve next.

Senior web strategy and growth judgment. You have shaped a website or landing-page strategy around business and customer needs. You can explain how you prioritized opportunities, weighed tradeoffs and evaluated results across acquisition, conversion and lead quality.
Creative and UX judgment. You recognize what makes a web experience clear, compelling and true to the brand. You give specific, constructive feedback that helps designers do their best work.
Hands-on web and content experience. You can show examples of page structures, messaging and copy you developed yourself, and explain your contribution and the reasoning behind it.
AI curiosity and adaptability. You stay current on how AI is reshaping websites and user journeys, and actively apply what you learn to improve both web experiences and the team’s workflows.

Practical experimentation and analysis skills. You can analyze research, funnel data and business insights to frame useful hypotheses and recognize uncertainty. You do not need to configure experiments or bring advanced statistical expertise; you work with CRO on those specialist areas.
Senior leadership and collaboration. You can lead web strategy independently, collaborate across disciplines and report results to senior leaders in large organizations.
Excellent English communication. Fluent spoken and written English is essential. You can present proposals, explain your reasoning and engage in constructive debate with senior stakeholders.
Product marketing, especially B2B. Experience translating customer and market insight into clear positioning and messaging for complex products or services.
Relevant industry experience. We value experience in marketplaces, in the restaurant industry, or with products or platforms for merchants.
Performance marketing. Experience connecting analytical and creative thinking to acquisition results, with an understanding of how campaigns and web experiences work together.

Startups, tech and established brands. Experience in startups or tech companies, alongside work with established brands or major accounts. We value the ability to adapt to different stages, constraints and ways of working.

Take a page from strategy to launch. This is what you’ll spend most of your time doing. Analyze the opportunity, define the page’s strategy and role within the site, and develop its structure, messaging, and copy. Partner with Design and Development, give feedback as the page takes shape, coordinate the launch, and review its performance.
Align product positioning and messaging across the site. Clarify what makes the product worth choosing and adapt that message to what visitors need to know on each page.
Build and prioritize the web roadmap. Work with the SEO/AEO and Paid teams to align on quarterly acquisition and conversion goals and how the website can help meet them.
Develop hypotheses to improve conversion across the site. Partner with the CRO specialists to identify where people get stuck and shape what to test.

Help shape how the website evolves in the AI era. Stay on top of how AI is changing how people discover and use websites. Turn those insights into experiments and coordinate with the teams that can put what works into practice.
Client and team alignment: The web strategy reflects the brand and business goals, with a shared understanding of priorities across the client and team.
A clearer, stronger web presence: The website reflects the brand’s positioning, makes the offer easy to understand and supports visibility in a world of AI-powered discovery.
Stronger acquisition and conversion: Evidence of progress in web acquisition and conversion on priority journeys, with lead quality considered alongside volume.

Iteration, learning and evolution: Ongoing experimentation with the CRO, SEO/AEO and Paid teams helps us scale what works across the site and adapt our web strategy as AI continues to change how websites work.

El rol

Como Digital Manager (SEO-GEO), liderarás la estrategia digital de la compañía en México: adquisición, contenido, redes sociales, SEO, performance y analítica, en apoyo de las marcas del portafolio y de los médicos, que son sus clientes.

Tu gran diferenciador será el posicionamiento: lograr que las marcas sean encontradas y elegidas tanto en buscadores tradicionales (SEO) como en las respuestas de asistentes y motores basados en inteligencia artificial (GEO, Generative Engine Optimization). Definir la estrategia digital y de performance por marca, con presupuesto y objetivos de retorno.

Construir y ejecutar la estrategia GEO para que el portafolio sea visible y recomendado en asistentes de IA y buscadores generativos.
Liderar al equipo digital (social, SEO, performance y contenido) y a las agencias especializadas.
Gestionar la adquisición digital y el performance en medios pagados.
Medir y analizar los resultados digitales e integrarlos con el CRM.
Desarrollar propuestas digitales que apoyen a los médicos en el crecimiento de su práctica.
Reportar indicadores clave y proponer mejoras de forma continua.


Perfil buscado


7 a 10 años de experiencia en marketing digital, con al menos 3 años liderando equipos.
Experiencia en salud, belleza, consumo premium o e-commerce.
Experiencia sólida en SEO y conocimiento o experiencia en GEO / AEO y en inteligencia artificial aplicada a búsqueda.
Experiencia integral en adquisición, performance, redes sociales, contenido y analítica.
Experiencia gestionando presupuestos digitales y agencias.
Conocimiento de CRM e integración de datos digitales.
Orientación a resultados, autonomía y organización.
Habilidades de comunicación y manejo de stakeholders, trabajo en equipo y mentalidad de mejora continua.
Licenciatura en Mercadotecnia, Comunicación, Administración o afín.
Español nativo; inglés intermedio deseable.
Disponibilidad para trabajar en Ciudad de México.


Qué ofrecemos


La oportunidad de liderar y construir la función digital de una compañía en plena expansión dentro de la estética médica.
Ser pionero/a en GEO, una disciplina que está redefiniendo cómo las marcas se hacen visibles.
Impacto directo en el crecimiento de un portafolio amplio de marcas.
Autonomía y un entorno ágil donde las ideas se ejecutan.

title: UGC & Affiliate Strategist
skills: Full-Funnel Creator & Affiliate Strategy: Design, launch, and scale end-to-end UGC and affiliate marketing funnels that drive measurable customer acquisition, first-time orders, and net revenue for e-commerce clients (including Shopify/Shopify Plus brands).

Creator Scouting & Vetting: Identify, evaluate, and recruit high-fit creators across Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and niche communities—prioritizing audience trust, purchase intent, and historical conversion performance over vanity follower metrics.

End-to-End Campaign & Compliance Management: Draft and negotiate creator agreements, secure paid/organic usage and licensing rights, manage product seeding/fulfillment logistics, and maintain strict publishing calendars.

Affiliate Tracking, Attribution & Payouts: Configure and QA unique referral links, discount codes, and tracking parameters; reconcile returns, resolve overlapping attributions, and calculate net commission payouts.

Omnichannel Content Repurposing: Curate, organize, and deploy approved creator assets across client websites (PDPs), organic social channels, and paid media funnels to maximize asset lifespan and conversion rates.

Performance Reporting & Unit Economics: Deliver weekly performance readouts measuring spend, traffic, orders, and true net contribution per creator, providing data-backed recommendations to scale top performers or pause underperforming placements.
Client & Roster Relationship Management: Act as the primary point of contact for both agency clients and creator rosters, translating campaign data into clear, actionable business updates.
Agency Experience: Proven track record working in a fast-paced digital marketing, growth, or e-commerce agency managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.

Affiliate & Conversion Funnel Expertise: Hands-on experience building performance-driven creator/affiliate funnels—not just brand awareness—with a strong grasp of CAC, ROAS, contribution margin, and conversion tracking.

Communication & English Proficiency: Near-native or fluent English with exceptional written and verbal communication skills for pitching creators, negotiating contracts, and leading client-facing strategy reviews.
Operational & Analytical Rigor: Highly organized self-starter comfortable managing contracts, usage rights, product shipments, and attribution spreadsheets/dashboards with zero drop-off.

E-Commerce & Platform Fluency: Deep familiarity with Instagram Reels, YouTube, TikTok, and e-commerce ecosystems (especially Shopify/Shopify Plus), plus experience integrating UGC into product pages and ad funnels.

Role Title: Research Marketing Lead (Remote)
Role Type: Full-time
Location: Remote




The Role

We’re looking for a Research Marketing Lead to own how our research, benchmarks, and technical work are positioned, launched, and adopted across the AI ecosystem.




You’ll work closely with our research team to turn technical work into high-impact launches that earn attention, adoption, and citations. You’ll develop a deep understanding of our research and methodology, shape positioning and narratives, establish a high quality bar for publication, and build go-to-market strategies that put our work in front of the right researchers, developers, AI labs, and technical audiences.




What You'll Do

1. Own research GTM end-to-end, developing launch and distribution strategies for research, benchmarks, evaluations, and other technical work.

2. Establish the publication-readiness bar for research and benchmarks, partnering with researchers to ensure methodology, claims, results, and supporting materials are rigorous, clear, and defensible before launch.

3. Develop positioning and narratives that translate complex technical findings into clear, differentiated stories without sacrificing technical accuracy or depth.

4. Identify high-impact research opportunities by understanding emerging AI trends, open questions, competitive research, and what matters to researchers and practitioners.

5. Shape research packaging and distribution, including research pages, benchmark releases, technical content, launch materials, and other assets that drive discovery and usage.

6. Build relationships across the AI research ecosystem, including researchers, AI labs, developers, technical communities, and influential practitioners.

7. Drive adoption of our research and benchmarks, identifying the audiences, communities, and channels most likely to use, reference, and build on our work.

8. Measure research impact, tracking adoption, citations, engagement, usage, and qualitative feedback to understand what resonates and where our work is creating value.

9. Create feedback loops between the market and research, bringing ecosystem insights back to the research team to inform future benchmarks, evaluations, and research priorities.




What We're Looking For

1. Experience marketing, launching, or driving adoption of technical research, AI/ML products, developer products, benchmarks, evaluations, or similarly complex technical work.

2. Strong track record developing and executing go-to-market strategies for technical audiences.

3. Ability to deeply understand technical work and translate it into clear, credible, differentiated positioning and narratives.

We are seeking a highly organized and strategic Marketing Resource Manager to become the operational backbone of our client campaigns. This role is for a natural leader who excels at the intersection of project management, client strategy, and marketing execution. You will be the strategic linchpin for our campaign delivery, ensuring all moving parts—from SEO and content to creative and client services—are perfectly synchronized and optimized for success.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For:

A Strategic Thinker & An Operational Expert

You can see the big picture of a client's business goals and can build and manage the detailed project plan to get there.

Data-Informed & Creatively-Minded

You respect the data and use it to guide decisions, but you also have a strong sense of brand and storytelling that helps you to understand the decision makers strategies.

A Master Orchestrator

You excel at bringing different specialists together (SEO, content, design) to work as a cohesive and effective unit. Your organizational skills are legendary.

An Expert Relationship Builder & Diplomat

Demonstrates strong diplomacy and relationship management skills, with a talent for managing diverse and high-performing personalities effectively.

An Agile Builder

Thrives in the building phase of a company's growth and possesses the agility to make quick pivots as priorities evolve.

Adaptable & Versatile

You have experience across various industries and can quickly grasp the marketing challenges and opportunities within new client verticals.

Client-Obsessed

You are dedicated to client success and have a proven ability to build strong, collaborative relationships.

5+ years of professional experience in marketing project management, account management, or marketing operations, preferably within a digital agency setting.

Demonstrable experience managing integrated digital marketing campaigns (SEO, content marketing, social media, etc.).

Strong, practical knowledge of SEO principles and how they inform a successful content strategy.

Exceptional client-facing communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.

Familiarity with tools like Google Workspace, Figma, and ChatGPT.

This role is not for everyone.

However, for the right person, the rewards are immense. You are not a cog in a machine here. You are a critical driver of our clients' success and our agency's growth. You will be challenged, you will grow faster than you thought possible, and you will see the direct, tangible impact of your strategic work every single day. description:
LinkedIn Content Strategist (USD - Remote)




📍 Location

Remote – Latin America




💼 Type: Full-time, 40 hours per week




⏰ Schedule

Monday to Friday, 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM PT (6:00 AM PT start is non-negotiable)




💻 Equipment: Your own laptop (Mac preferred) with Notion and Claude installed, a working camera for client calls and a stable internet connection




About the Role

You'll join a LinkedIn personal branding company that turns founders and executives (many from PE-backed companies) into market-facing authorities. You'll work side by side with the founder, a staff writer and designers, and you'll be the main point of contact for every client engagement, from kickoff to renewal. Your early start lets you prepare work, publish and respond to clients in Europe before the US team comes online.




You'll handle two very different types of clients at the same time. Busy C-level clients have to be followed up on so they finish their intake, interviews and approvals. High-volume creators (100K+ followers) post daily and need fast turnaround on content and lead magnets. Over time you'll take day-to-day delivery off the founder's plate and run the operation with a high degree of autonomy.




Core Client Success & Content Responsibilities

Lead kickoffs, strategy calls and monthly reviews as the main point of contact for executive clients, and drive retention, renewals and upsells
Follow up with less responsive clients so they complete their intake survey, interviews and post approvals, and make sure every package is used in full
Define each client's strategic positioning and what they want to be known for, using the company's methodology (intake survey, interview and a custom AI persona tool) and your own judgment
Audit and rebuild LinkedIn profiles as sales pages (headline, About, Featured, banner, experience), and brief the designers on banners and visuals
Review every post before it ships (hook, story, value, CTA), and write posts from scratch, often live on a call with a client, in the client's voic
Build and optimize lead magnets, lead generation flows and sponsored/target ads, using UTM-tagged links to track what drives calls and pipeline
Improve the performance of video content and sponsored ads on LinkedIn
Report monthly on reach, profile views, inbound DMs, booked calls and pipeline, in plain language
Run the delivery engine in Notion (client portals, content calendars, approval flows, SOPs, dashboards), and manage the writer and designers with clear briefs and deadlines
Use AI (Claude skills, projects and MCP, ChatGPT) and AI agents to optimize workflows and scale delivery, and liaise with LinkedIn support on features and Sales Navigator for clients




Must-Haves

3+ years in content strategy, personal branding or B2B marketing, ideally around 5 years in client-facing roles
Proven experience owning accounts with senior, demanding clients (executives or founders)
Deep understanding of the LinkedIn ecosystem: what performs, profile conversion, post anatomy, video and sponsored content
Strong writing skills: able to write high-performing LinkedIn posts from scratch without AI, then use AI to scale
Strong project management: able to juggle many clients and deadlines and keep the operation on track
Experience with lead magnets, lead generation and targeted ads, including UTM tracking
Advanced Notion skills (databases, templates, dashboards)
Daily, hands-on use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, MCP connectors, agents) to automate andimprove workflows
Experience directing designers and writers, with a creative eye and strong attention to detail
High drive, leadership and resourcefulness: proactive, persistent and comfortable working without a playbook
Professional English, verbal and written, strong enough to write in the voice of US executives
Available to start at 6:00 AM PT every working day (non-negotiable)




Nice to Have

Agency background, especially at a creative or high-volume agency
PMP or formal project management certification
Has grown their own LinkedIn audience
HubSpot, Granola, ManyChat, Riverside and Canva
LinkedIn analytics/scheduling tools (e.g., AuthoredUp or similar) and Sales Navigator

Team Intro
The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated.
With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better commerce experience to our users. We are looking for a passionate and strategic Creator Manager to join our team. You will be responsible for discovering, incubating, and educating e-commerce creators, with a focus on helping vertical creators improve their sales performance. You will collaborate closely with industry teams to match high-potential creators with quality content formats, including short videos and live streaming. Additionally, you will support major campaigns, marketing initiatives, and creator education efforts by providing relevant content and guidance. A key part of your role will be working with the content moderation team to educate creators on platform policies and ensure compliance.

- Identify, onboard, and incubate e-commerce creators within specific verticals to drive sales growth.  
- Develop and implement strategies to scale creator success, leveraging data insights to guide decision-making.  
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Category, Marketing, Campaign operations) to match creators with suitable content opportunities and promotional activities.  
- Provide ongoing education and support to creators, helping them optimize content strategy, understand platform rules, and improve performance.  
- Work with the content moderation team to ensure creators adhere to platform guidelines and policies.

Qualifications

- Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable plans.  
- Service-oriented mindset, patience, and excellent communication skills to support and educate creators.  
- Fast learner who can quickly absorb information and effectively teach others.  
- Team player with a strong sense of responsibility and a positive, can-do attitude.  
- Proficient in data analysis and comfortable using metrics to drive decisions.

description:
Join a team that puts people at the center of everything.




At TLNT, we believe that recruitment is more than just filling roles — it's about connecting humans with humans. We're a people-first organization partnering with top U.S. companies to help them grow by attracting exceptional talent, and we know that the right content can open the right doors.




This is an excellent opportunity to grow your career with a leading US-based company — fully remote.




You'll join a fast-growing, woman-owned clean skincare brand, handmade in small batches in Florida with simple, fragrance-free ingredients. It started in a kitchen, outgrew a barn and then a warehouse, and today speaks to a community of more than half a million followers on social media — an audience that shows up for real people, real products, and honest ingredient education, not filters.




As Video Editor (Paid Social), you'll turn the in-house team's raw footage and product and lifestyle photography into polished, high-performing content for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. The marketing team owns strategy, concepts, and briefs; you own the edit — video first, supported by static design and graphics.




This is not an entry-level role. You've spent years editing short-form for established e-commerce or DTC brands, and you know how to package a physical product so it sells. Most content is organic, and the best performers become paid ads. Expected output is around 10–15 videos and 10–15 graphics a week. The focus is editing and creative development — not filming, photography, or account management.




What You'll Do

Short-form video. Edit Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts from raw footage, following creative briefs and brand guidelines.
Hooks, captions and sound. Add captions, subtitles, hooks, music, and text overlays that read and sound natural to the brand's audience.

description:
Traild: Who are we?  
Traild is a high-growth SaaS company redefining how finance teams operate, combining AI, automation, and payments infrastructure to power the future of B2B finance.

Every year, businesses lose billions to fraud, errors, and mistakes. Traild exists to solve this at scale, helping finance teams move faster, stay in control, and operate with confidence.

With rapid customer growth, global expansion across APAC, North America and EMEA, and continued investment in product innovation, we are at a defining stage of our journey.

This is an opportunity to help shape the next category leader in finance automation, control and security, building technology that transforms how businesses manage, move, and protect money. At the core of this is a powerful AI-driven platform, enabling finance teams to deploy intelligent agents that do the work, surface risk in real time, and continuously improve how financial operations run.

Traild is building the infrastructure behind modern finance, protecting and powering meaningful volumes of the world’s B2B transactions.

If you’re excited by high growth, real ownership, and building something that matters, Traild is the place to do the most impactful work of your career.

About
Hear how Traild customers speak about us here.

The Role
As Traild scales, our clients are getting bigger and more strategic. We already have an Enterprise Implementation role, and now we need an Enterprise Customer Success Manager to care for these accounts after go-live. This is the first role of its kind here, so you will help shape how it works as we learn what our largest customers need.

You will own a portfolio of high-value accounts, acting as trusted advisor and advocate for client leadership and day-to-day teams. You will build long-term success strategies, protect and grow revenue, and turn happy clients into public references. Expect ambiguity, change, and plenty of room to make your mark.

This is a full-time, remote and open to candidates across North America. Some early morning or evening calls will be needed to work with our development teams in APAC and EMEA.

Key Responsibilities


Manage a portfolio of strategic and enterprise-level accounts as their primary point of contact and advocate
Develop long-term success strategies with each customer, aligned to their goals and desired outcomes
Drive revenue retention and expansion, partnering with Sales on upsell and cross-sell opportunities

Plan and deliver Executive Business Reviews (EBRs), building the value narrative for client leadership
Manage escalations end to end: pull in Engineering and Product, turn client concerns into action, and keep stakeholders updated
Follow up on roadmap commitments and interim fixes with Product and Engineering
Monitor usage, health, and support activity daily to spot early escalation risks
Spot trends across the customer base and share them with Product, Support, and Sales
Turn successful clients into references
Contribute to documentation and mentor junior team members




Who You Are
You are a proactive and customer-obsessed professional who thrives on building relationships, solving problems, and driving customer value. You understand the customer journey end-to-end and excel at helping clients succeed post-onboarding. You are confident engaging with stakeholders at all levels and enjoy working in a fast-moving, scaling environment. You are at ease with executives, you think commercially, and you thrive in a start-up where the role is still taking shape and the path is not always clear.

Advanced English proficiency (CEFR C1 or equivalent) — both written and spoken

This role is open exclusively to candidates based in Canada, Mexico or Colombia. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in the United States at this time.

Optimizar taxonomía, búsquedas y navegación de 3 multisitios mediante datos para maximizar la conversión y experiencia del usuario.

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for an Analyst, Digital Media Analytics who will support the measurement and reporting of B2B advertising campaigns for a global professional services client.

In this role, you will use T-SQL, Power BI, and Excel to extract, organize, analyze, and visualize campaign data. You will collaborate with Investment, Planning, and senior Analytics teams to ensure accurate reporting, monitor campaign performance and spend pacing, and identify gaps in the data.

Key responsibilities include:


Extract, organize, and format campaign data from advertising management platforms to support analysis and reporting. 
Use T-SQL and Excel to retrieve, prepare, and analyze data, supporting accurate and consistent campaign reporting. 
Maintain, update, and perform quality assurance checks on dashboards and recurring reports in Power BI and Tableau. 
Produce campaign performance and spend pacing reports across multiple campaigns and client service lines. 
Perform recurring tracking tag QA checks to verify correct functionality and support accurate data flows. 
Help senior Analytics team members translate media metrics into clear visualizations and presentations that support decision-making. 
Review campaign objectives and performance data with the team to identify optimization opportunities and potential measurement solutions. 
Collaborate with Investment and Planning teams to gather campaign information and ensure complete reporting coverage. 
Identify and help resolve data gaps, discrepancies, and reporting issues, working with relevant teams to improve information quality. 


Skills And Experience

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:


1–2 years of relevant professional experience in data analytics, reporting, business intelligence, or digital media analytics. 
Hands-on experience with data extraction, organization, and analysis. 
Practical experience using T-SQL to retrieve and analyze data. 
Experience using Power BI to maintain dashboards, visualize information, and support reporting. 
Proficiency in Excel for preparing, organizing, and analyzing datasets. 
Strong attention to detail and the ability to validate data, identify discrepancies, and maintain reporting accuracy. 
Good communication skills, with the ability to explain findings clearly and coordinate with different stakeholders. 
A collaborative approach to working with Investment, Planning, and Analytics teams. 
Organizational skills to support multiple campaigns and recurring reporting deadlines. 
Experience with Databricks is a plus. 


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

description:
Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information.  Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes.  With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters.  Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach.  Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

What You’ll Do

The Project Manager plays a key role within Teradata's Corporate Marketing Project Management Office (PMO). 

This role sits at the intersection of marketing operations and digital execution.  You build clarity for others by taking ambiguous requests from multiple stakeholders, defining the work, and driving to a clear output.  You own project outcomes; the production team (including content publishers, copywriters and designers) support execution and follow-through under your guidance.

Responsibilities


Own end-to-end project management across multiple concurrent marketing campaigns, digital programs, and content initiatives.  
Build and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, and deliverable trackers in Trello; keep all task cards, due dates, and assignees current.  
Run intake and kick-off calls with stakeholders to scope requests, define objectives, and document requirements in partnership with the relevant campaign or content manager.  
Assign and sequence tasks across cross-functional teams; proactively identify dependencies and surface blockers before they impact deadlines.  
Manage dependencies, sequencing, and handoffs across programs and channels to prevent bottlenecks and ensure integrated execution.  
Send weekly status communications to all project participants; escalate risks to the PMO Director with clear context and a recommended path forward.  
Flag resource constraints, competing priorities, and workload imbalances proactively so resourcing decisions can be made with full context.  
Manage stakeholder relationships across multiple business units — Product Marketing, Partner/Field Marketing, and Corporate Marketing.  
Navigate competing priorities across stakeholder groups; set clear expectations on scope, timelines, and trade-offs without escalating unnecessarily.  
Facilitate alignment meetings and working sessions; prepare agendas, capture decisions, and distribute action items to keep all parties moving.  


Who You’ll Work With

You partner closely with the PMO Director and stakeholders across to plan, track, and deliver marketing campaigns and digital programs end to end, operating within a PMO that spans web and digital channels, campaigns, events, marketing automation, and AI initiatives across Teradata.

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate


3+ years of experience in a project coordination, project management, or marketing operations role.  
Demonstrable experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced marketing environment.  
Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders including creatives, marketers, developers, and legal.  


Tools & systems 


Trello — daily task and project tracking; Teradata's primary Project Management Office tool.  
Jira — active workflow tool for issue tracking and sprint-style project management; working knowledge preferred.  
Smartsheet — used for broader program planning; familiarity a plus.  
Microsoft 365 — Teams, SharePoint, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel for day-to-day collaboration and documentation.  
DAM platforms — experience with digital asset management systems preferred.  


What You’ll Bring


Strong organizational skills — you maintain systems, and don’t let a deadline slip silently.  
Builds clarity for others — you can take ambiguous requests, define the work, and drive to a clear output.  
Clear written communicator — comfortable writing status updates, meeting recaps, and stakeholder-facing copy.  
Collaborative — you make it easy for busy stakeholders to work with you.  
Curious about AI tools and comfortable experimenting with new technology as part of your workflow.  




Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. title: Campaign Manager - Remote Work
description:
WinDifferent specializes in helping businesses achieve rapid and sustainable growth through our powerful proprietary marketing system. Our data-driven solutions generate positive engagement that leads to ready-to-close opportunities, massively expanding sales pipelines and enabling companies to scale faster than the competition.




As one of WinDifferent's best success stories, BairesDev helps us to find the best talent worldwide and invites them to explore our continually growing job opportunities.




Campaign Manager at WinDifferent




As a Campaign Manager at WinDifferent, you'll be responsible for owning the full lifecycle of email campaigns, from understanding our partners' products, ICPs, and sales funnels to launching and optimizing targeted, high-performing campaigns. You'll manage a portfolio of around 30 partner accounts at a time, requiring strong organization, time management, and communication skills. Daily responsibilities include meeting with partners, crafting and segmenting campaigns, coordinating with internal teams, tracking performance, and continuously testing and iterating for better results. You'll also use AI tools throughout your work and contribute to AI projects that improve our internal processes and campaign optimization. Your core objectives are to hit campaign performance goals, keep partners engaged and satisfied, and help improve how the team runs campaigns. The role is both strategic and hands-on, offering the challenge of balancing creativity, data, and partner relationships to drive measurable impact.




What you will do:




- Collaborate closely with multiple WinDifferent clients to gather requirements, understand their value proposition, and align on key messaging, goals, and campaign strategy.

- Analyze each client's product or service to identify their unique selling points and tailor email campaigns that resonate with their Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).

- Oversee the full project lifecycle of email campaigns, managing timelines, coordinating with internal teams, handling multiple client accounts, and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality campaigns.

- Develop, segment, and execute targeted email marketing campaigns, while continuously monitoring performance metrics to iterate and optimize for engagement and conversions.

- Implement and manage A/B testing strategies to refine messaging, design, and calls to action, leveraging results to maximize lead generation and overall campaign effectiveness.




What we are looking for:




- 4+ years of marketing experience.

- 2+ years in client-facing roles.

- 2+ years in project or account management.

- 2+ years working at or with international companies.

- Experience managing marketing email campaigns.

- Good level of English.




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work.

- Work-from-home hardware setup.

- Flexible hours - make your schedule.

- PTO, parental leave, and other special leaves.

- English classes.

- Personal loans with 0% interest, following the company's policies.

- Udemy for Business (subject to manager's approval).

- An excellent compensation package — well above the market average.

- You can grow at the speed of your learning curve.

- An innovation-driven, diverse, and multicultural work environment that provides the support and resources for its professionals to thrive.

- The chance and resources to be a game-changer for one of America's fastest-growing companies.




Join a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive and make a significant impact!




Apply Now!

Descripción Empresa

El Puerto de Liverpool es la empresa líder en tiendas departamentales en México. Con más de 170 años en el mercado, nos dedicamos a facilitar la selección de productos y brindarles el mejor servicio a las familias mexicanas, esperando superar las expectativas de calidad, moda, valor y atención dentro de un ambiente agradable.

Contamos con cinco unidades de negocio: Tiendas Liverpool, Tiendas Suburbia, Centros Comerciales Galerías, Boutiques y Negocios Financieros, componiendo una empresa sólida, que ofrece a sus colaboradores estabilidad financiera y el orgullo de pertenecer a una empresa 100% Mexicana.

Nuestra misión es servir al cliente en todo lugar, todos los días, toda la vida, nuestra visión es ser la mejor opción en servicio, surtido y valor. Nuestros valores nos guían hacia el trabajo en equipo, productividad, innovación e integridad.

Misión Del Cargo

Liderar la estrategia digital de centros comerciales de Galerías, para potenciar el posicionamiento de marca y flujo de visitantes

Funciones Del Cargo

Ejecución de campañas y contenidos: Administrar la pauta publicitaria en medios digitales y la actualización de contenidos web (CMS) y redes sociales para la red de centros comerciales.

title: Sr Product Manager - Retention
skills: Choose the right bets. Identify the client segments and problems worth solving. Own the roadmap and allocate effort against expected client value, commercial impact, and engineering cost. Set the baseline, target, and threshold for scaling; stop weak bets.

Build NTU retention. Help newly transacting users build on their first transaction, discover further value, and form repeat investing and financial habits through their first weeks and months. Find where they stall and improve the steps that lead to lasting use.

Retain and bring back established clients. Keep active clients engaged, address signs of lapsing, and reactivate clients who have stopped. Understand how needs change with tenure, holdings, and financial goals, then deepen the client’s relationship with Kraken.

Make the next financial move useful. Test ways to support client intent: recurring deposits and buys, useful portfolio context, timely opportunities, or relevant Earn products. Choose from the evidence. Successful automated investing and Earn can create lasting value without frequent manual activity. Make rewards, access, and risks clear.

Prove the commercial impact. Track retention by cohort and segment, linking behavior to retained balances, net inflows, product adoption, and revenue. Measure active engagement through useful actions, such as reviewing a portfolio or investing, and track successful automated habits separately. Distinguish inflows from asset-price gains, establish incremental impact, account for incentives and costs, and check that gains last after promotions end.

Connect product and lifecycle. Partner with lifecycle marketing on push, email, web, and app journeys, from a relevant message to a useful financial action. Adapt to local payment habits and market requirements.

Build and ship with the team. Turn the chosen problem into prototypes, requirements, and experiments with engineering, design, and data. Bring risk, compliance, and legal partners into design decisions. Balance client impact, reliability, maintainability, and delivery speed; scale what works.

Evidence that you’ve personally led consumer product changes that beat retention or expansion targets. Be ready to explain the baseline, target, result, timeframe, and your contribution, including the impact on revenue, assets, or retained balances.

A clear account of what changed underneath the result: component behaviors or funnel rates such as repeat deposits, return-to-transaction conversion, successful recurring investments, or reactivation. Show how you established incremental impact and whether it lasted.
Strong client and product judgment. You can choose a segment and problem worth pursuing, understand why clients return, hold, withdraw, or disengage, and turn that insight into a useful experience.
Hands-on analytical depth. You query and validate your own data, diagnose cohorts and funnels, size opportunities, and design experiments that can detect a commercially meaningful effect.
Commercial discipline. You can explain how market conditions, incentives, costs, and client trust affected your results, and use that evidence to decide whether an improvement is worth scaling.

Senior ownership from decision through delivery. You’ve owned a roadmap, made product and technical trade-offs, allocated effort, stopped weak bets, and worked effectively with engineering, design, data, lifecycle marketing, and risk/compliance partners.
Experience with consumer investing, wealth, savings, fintech, or crypto products. Freemium gaming is nice-to-have as well.
Experience building recurring investment, deposit, Earn, portfolio, or goal-based experiences.
Experience adapting client journeys across markets and local financial behaviors.
description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Consumer Growth builds mobile and web experiences that help people become Kraken customers, fund their accounts, invest, earn, access new products, build wealth and stay lifelong clients. Product, engineering, design, data, and lifecycle marketing build together.

What You Bring

Senior ownership from decision through delivery. You’ve owned a roadmap, made product and technical trade-offs, allocated effort, stopped weak bets, and worked effectively with engineering, design, data, lifecycle marketing, and risk/compliance partners.


Nice to haves


Experience with consumer investing, wealth, savings, fintech, or crypto products. Freemium gaming is nice-to-have as well.
Experience building recurring investment, deposit, Earn, portfolio, or goal-based experiences.
Experience adapting client journeys across markets and local financial behaviors.

Join Ingredion, where innovation impacts lives worldwide! Without even realizing it, you’ve experienced our work in your favorite chocolate, your pet’s food, the paper you write on, and your everyday snacks. Whether you’re just starting your career or bringing years of experience, there's a place for you here to make a real difference. Position Title: Director, Global Sales Operations

Location: Bridgewater NJ / Westchester Ill. / or Mexico City / Guadalajara

Workplace type: Hybrid/ On Site

The Head of Growth (paid media) will lead creative strategy, paid media buying across Meta, Google, YouTube and TikTok (with Meta as the top priority), funnel strategy, offer creation and copywriting. 




This person will take full ownership of marketing from day one. There is no extended onboarding period, so the right candidate is comfortable stepping in, assessing what’s running, and making decisions right away.




This is not a standard 9-to-5 position. The role requires someone who is fully committed and available for extended hours throughout the US business day.




Key Responsibilities:




Ownership and Strategy

- Take full ownership of marketing from the first week

- Review all active campaigns, offers and funnels, and decide what to keep, improve or stop

- Own performance results and respond quickly when numbers change

- Set marketing direction and priorities to drive revenue growth




Paid Media and Media Buying

- Manage paid performance across Meta, Google, YouTube and TikTok, with Meta as the primary channel

- Plan, launch and manage campaigns, including structure, audiences, budgets and bids

- Run ongoing creative testing to identify top-performing ads

- Scale successful campaigns and shut down underperforming ones

- Set and meet ROAS targets

- Monitor performance throughout the day and make fast adjustments

- Allocate budget across platforms based on revenue impact




Offer Creation

- Develop offers that drive purchases, including what’s included, pricing and positioning

- Test offers and angles to identify the strongest performers

- Refine offers based on customer response




Funnel Strategy

- Map the full customer journey from first ad click to purchase

- Identify drop-off points and improve conversion

- Make sure ads, offers and landing pages work together as one clear path to purchase




Creative Strategy

- Define the angles, hooks and messaging for ad testing

- Plan creative tests and use results to guide future creative

- Maintain a steady pipeline of new, high-performing creative




Copywriting

- Write ad copy that drives clicks

- Write funnel and landing page copy that converts

- Keep messaging clear and consistent across every touchpoint




Qualifications

- Expert-level Meta ads experience with proven, measurable results

- Hands-on experience running paid campaigns on Google, YouTube and TikTok

- A proven track record of creating offers that sell

- Strong experience in creative strategy, media buying, funnel strategy and copywriting

- A strong ownership mindset and the ability to work independently from day one

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Willingness to work extended hours with high availability during US business hours




This role is not for you, if you:

- Are looking for a fixed 9-to-5 schedule

- Prefer to execute someone else’s strategy

- Need a long ramp-up period before taking on responsibility




Work Arrangement

- Fully remote

- Independent contractor agreement

- Extended hours with high availability during US business hours

- Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated workspace required

- Long-term opportunity for the right candidate-

description:
Description

As a Senior Account Executive at Amazon Ads Mexico, you will own the strategy and growth of a portfolio of the largest and most complex advertisers in Mexico. With a consultative approach and deep expertise in advertising technology and measurement, you will be a trusted advisor to senior marketing and media leaders. You will design integrated solutions across streaming TV, Prime Video, live sports, Twitch, display, audio and Sponsored Ads that help them reach their business goals. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, tackle ambiguous problems, and influence the direction of the broader sales organization.

Amazon Ads is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brand advertisers, agencies, authors and entrepreneurs. Our ad solutions, including sponsored ads, display, streaming TV/video, audio and custom ads, use Amazon's innovations and insights to find, attract and engage audiences throughout their daily journeys. With flexible pricing and buying models, including self-service, managed service and programmatic buying, these solutions help businesses build brand awareness, grow sales and more.

This is an opportunity to lead relationships with some of the largest brands and agency holding companies in the market, and to shape how they invest in video and advanced advertising. If you have a consultative selling style, experience selling advertising at a leading technology or digital platform company, and a passion for developing others while delivering strategic, data-driven solutions, apply today!

Key job responsibilities

Own the account strategy for a portfolio of top advertisers, including multi-year growth plans and annual commitment negotiations.

Lead executive engagement by building relationships with C-level and senior media and marketing leaders at advertisers and agencies.

Build and run full-funnel strategies, from big ideas to analytical recommendations, with video as a key driver of growth.

Serve as an ad tech and measurement subject matter expert for the team. Coach peers on DSP activation, programmatic deals, clean rooms and advanced measurement.

Design measurement plans, such as brand lift, reach and frequency analysis, and attribution, that show the business impact of your clients' investments.

Mentor and coach other sellers, give feedback on client pitches, and help onboard new team members.

Build best practices that scale across the team, such as playbooks, account planning frameworks and AI-driven automations.

Influence product and leadership by bringing customer and market insights into product roadmaps and business planning.

Use Salesforce, data and generative AI tools to manage pipeline, track account health and forecast against quarterly goals.

Keep up with trends in the advertising industry, ad tech and the competitive landscape in Mexico.

This role requires five days a week in the office, with travel as needed.

Basic Qualifications


 7+ years of digital media or advertising sales experience
 5+ years of B2B sales experience managing strategic or enterprise advertisers and agencies
 Experience building C-level relationships with advertisers and agency leaders
 Professional fluency in Spanish and English
 Experience closing complex, multi-product deals and consistently exceeding large revenue targets
 Experience selling video, CTV, display or programmatic advertising solutions, including negotiating annual or commitment-based agreements


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience selling advertising solutions at a global technology, digital platform or online media company
 Advanced knowledge of the advertising technology stack: DSPs, programmatic deal types (PG, PMP, open exchange), audience strategy and data clean rooms
 Experience with advertising measurement solutions such as brand lift studies, MMM, matched market tests and multi-touch attribution
 Experience leading large, multi-stakeholder deals, such as joint business plans, annual commitments or custom sponsorships
 Experience acting as a subject matter expert in ad tech, programmatic or measurement, and coaching others in it
 Experience shaping go-to-market strategy for a vertical or a portfolio of accounts
 Experience mentoring other sellers or leading cross-functional working groups

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Manager Search who will:


Develop strong working relationships with WPP Media regional teams across Europe, the United States, and Asia.
Ensure the consistent application of Paid Search best practices, promoting platform expertise, accuracy, and high-quality campaign delivery.
Oversee the quality and consistency of team deliverables, ensuring they meet the expectations of WPP Media regional teams.
Serve as the point of escalation for the team, taking ownership of resolving challenges and coordinating solutions.
Directly manage a team of 2–5 direct reports, supporting their performance and professional development.
Provide timely, actionable feedback to help team members improve their work and progress in their careers.
Recognize strong performance and team achievements, reinforcing a supportive and collaborative working environment.


Skills And Experience

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:


A bachelor’s degree.
Advanced English proficiency (B2–C2), with the ability to communicate effectively with international teams.
3+ years of experience managing Paid Search campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Bing Ads, Search Ads 360 (SA360), and Amazon Search.
At least 1 year of leadership experience.
Advanced Excel skills.


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

This position is available in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality and must be performed from any location within Mexico or Colombia. Only candidates residing in either country who are legally authorized to work there may apply. Remote work from outside Mexico or Colombia, including relocation abroad under a remote work contract, is not permitted under any circumstances.

We are designed for the new communications economy — built on data & technology, built for people & algorithms, built around diverse schools of thought, built to test & learn at scale, and, crucially, built to evolve.

Lead the regional strategic agenda, translating business challenges, consumer understanding and market opportunities into actionable brand, media and experience strategies that drive sustainable growth.

Stronger client business and brand outcomes.

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specialising in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

Role Summary:

As the Customer Development Executive – Digital & E-commerce, you will sit on the commercial team to lead the digital operations for Filorga within Colgate-Palmolive's CP Skin Health division. This is a unique opportunity to build and scale the digital ecosystem from the ground up for a high-growth French medical skincare brand. Ultimately, your single most important mission will be to drive profitable net sales growth across Amazon, Mercado Libre, and Shopify B2B.

Responsibilities:


Own Marketplace Commercial Strategy & Execution: Manage Amazon Vendor Central and Mercado Libre official store operations—including digital shelf optimization (A+ content, Brand Stores), annual promotional event calendars, retail media budgets (ROAS), and Supply Chain demand forecasting to maximize weekly sell-out and prevent stockouts. 
Lead Channel Financial Operations & Reconciliation: Partner closely with Finance, Credit & Collections, and CS&L to execute monthly financial closings, reconcile marketplace deductions (chargebacks, shortages, co-op, commissions), dispute invalid claims, and ensure timely SAP-integrated CFDI invoicing and credit notes for Shopify B2B. 
Enforce Brand Protection & Price Governance: Safeguard reference pricing across marketplaces, executing test buys, and collaborating with Legal to manage Amazon Brand Registry and Mercado Libre Brand Protection takedowns against unauthorized sellers. 
Scale B2B Medical E-commerce & Omnichannel Traffic: Operate and roll out the Shopify B2B platform for physicians (catalog, tiered pricing, onboarding, and adoption tracking) while coordinating with Inside Sales on AI ordering tools, Prescribe & Ship, and the clinic locator to drive patient traffic back to doctors' offices. 


Required Qualifications:

title: Emerging Channels Sr. Manager
skills: Channel Strategy and Prioritization: Define and execute the Emerging Channels strategy across Latin America (LATAM), setting priorities by channel, market, and customer. Assess consumer consumption occasions, potential outlet coverage, current brand performance, projected sales volume, brand visibility, execution feasibility, and profitability to identify growth opportunities and guide resource allocation.

Channel Expansion and Strategic Partnerships: Identify and pursue regional and local business opportunities in collaboration with bottlers, global and regional key accounts, quick-service restaurant chains, catering operators, vending partners, and digital platforms. Manage commercial initiatives from opportunity identification and proposal preparation through negotiations, implementation, and post-launch performance evaluation.

Customer Value Propositions and Joint Business Planning: Design of customer specific value propositions and joint business plans aimed at increasing category value, attracting new consumers, and expanding consumption occasions.

Define initiatives covering product portfolio listings, meal combinations, snacking occasions, specialty beverages and nonalcoholic cocktails, accessible pricing, promotional calendars, branded coolers, customer incentives, and experiential activations.

Channel Execution and Commercial Standards: Establish channel-specific execution standards for product availability, portfolio assortment, pricing, competitive positioning against carbonated soft drinks, chilled-product placement, brand visibility, physical and digital menu presence, and promotional activities. Work with country teams and bottlers to monitor outlet performance, address execution gaps, and ensure consistent application of agreed standards.

Cross-Functional Alignment and Bottler Collaboration: Coordinate global, regional, and local stakeholders to align commercial priorities and support effective execution across markets. Partner with bottlers and customers, engage Marketing and Trade Marketing teams in initiative planning, facilitate required brand approvals, and ensure projected incremental demand is reflected in Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP).

Pilot Programs and Market Expansion: Lead pilot initiatives by defining objectives, financial assumptions, operational requirements, and performance indicators. Assess outcomes, capture lessons learned, establish implementation guidelines, and replicate successful approaches across customers and markets. Support capability building through guidance and training for country teams and bottler partners.

Business Analytics and Performance Management: Maintain performance scorecards and analytical tools to inform commercial decisions across channels, customers, countries, and bottlers. Leverage internal and external data to assess growth drivers, untapped opportunities, and barriers to expansion. Track sales volume, distribution, rate of sale, product availability, commercial investments, and initiative performance against established objectives.

Financial Assessment and Investment Prioritization: Evaluate business cases and financial viability across the value chain, considering consumer pricing, profit margins, customer and bottler economics, commercial and marketing investments, and projected incremental sales volume. Recommend investment priorities, resource allocation, and corrective actions based on financial and operational results.

People leadership and operating discipline: Set priorities and performance expectations for the team, establish a consistent operating cadence, remove barriers and foster collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement and disciplined follow-through.
Prefer a Bachelor's Degree in the field of Business Administration, Management, Finance, Marketing, Economics or a related field
Additional Experience Desired: More than 5 years of experience in business development, key account management
Additional Experience Desired: Between 3-5 years of experience in channel ownership and commercial strategy leadership
Computer Skills Desired: Advanced Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; strong proficiency in Power BI or comparable Business Intelligence (BI) tools.

Additional Knowledge or Skills to be Successful in this role: Master’s degree preferred. Fluency in English and Spanish required; Portuguese strongly preferred. Experience managing direct reports and regional initiatives required. Background in beverages, Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), foodservice, or bottler operations strongly preferred. Demonstrated expertise in customer negotiations, Joint Business Plans (JBPs), channel profitability, pricing, business cases, field execution, and product launches.

description:
MERCHANDISING AND GLOBAL OPERATIONS MANAGER

We could say we’re a men’s flannel brand, but that wouldn’t do us justice. We’ve been the Highest Ranked Flannel in 2024, 2025, and 2026 by GearJunkie, going toe-to-toe with the heavyweights of the outdoor world and winning. Even Joe Rogan called us “the best damn flannel in the world.”




Our customers rave about our products, and our sales reflect the truth: we’re on to something big. But we know we can push further faster, and that’s where YOU come in. This job description is just the beginning. What matters most is your passion for creating something great every single day. We’re looking for grit, adaptability, and a hands-on approach to operating that goes beyond the scope of any role description.




THE ROLE

At MuskOx, we believe great products build great brands. As the Merchandising and Global Operations Manager, you will lead how our products are made, from first idea to delivery to our customers. This role is very hands-on and works across many teams. You will manage our global supply chain and production schedule across our mills (where our premium flannel fabric is made), factories (where the cut & sew happens), and our 3PL (where inventory is stored and shipped). Our partners are in Europe, North America, and South America, so keeping timelines on track, managing international shipping, and keeping operations running smoothly are the most important parts of this role.




You will also lead our product expansion and quality control. You will help decide what new products we make next and set strict quality checks so every new piece meets the high standards our customers expect. You will work closely with our designer to turn their ideas into a business plan, deciding how many units to make, how to price them, and which styles to offer in future apparel collections.




With a focus on new ideas, high quality, and hard work, you will help us grow profit, improve product quality, and run more efficiently.




REQUIREMENTS & RESPONSIBILITIES

Here’s the background and experience we value:

Detail oriented, consistently showing your ability to create order from chaos so timelines are met, relationships are managed, and processes are clean and organized
